contributions.statement: When a change is localized to one module, do not spend the context budget on a repository-wide expansion pass: on SWE-bench Verified the matched context swap added 17 solves on django and none on matplotlib, pylint, seaborn, and flask, inside an overall move from 352/500 (70.4%) to 393/500 (78.6%).
contributions.evidence: §IV-D RQ4 and Fig. 3, paired McNemar p<0.01. Caveats: the host agent and model are never named, there is one protocol and no repeat, and §I calls 70.4% the best baseline while §IV-B says it is the matched native context builder.

contributions.statement: Do not accept a file-recovery plugin on full-recall alone when micro precision stays near 10%: on the 27 medium tasks every method, including DeepDiscovery at 92.6% full recall, kept a predicted set in which about nine of ten files were outside the expert gold set (micro precision 10.0–11.3%).
contributions.evidence: Table I and §IV-C. The same band appears across six hosts in Table II (about 8.9–11.9%). Caveats: three-run min–max only, one company's tasks, gold sets average about five files (135/27), and ranges for full recall overlap the strongest baselines.

reason: What survives is a boundary, not the abstract's point ranges. Use a structured expansion pass on cross-file tasks, and require a precision cap beside full-file recall, because every reported method sits near 10% micro precision. The component ablation and the Table IV medium deltas do not survive.
